sn45.163:1.5: imesaṃ kho bhikkhave, tiṇṇannaṃ āsavānaṃ abhiññāya …pe… pariññāya …pe… parikkhayāya …pe… pahānāya ariyo aṭṭhaṅgiko maggo? idha bhikkhave, bhikkhu sammādiṭṭhiṃ bhāveti …pe… sammāsamādhiṃ bhāveti vivekanissitaṃ virāganissitaṃ nirodhanissitaṃ vossaggapariṇāmiṃ. imāsaṃ kho bhikkhave, tiṇṇannaṃ āsavānaṃ abhiññāya …pe… pariññāya …pe… parikkhayāya …pe… pahānāya ayaṃ ariyo aṭṭhaṅgiko maggo bhāvetabboti.
